title: Rome
tagline: The rise and fall of Rome

hook.deadpan: 264 BC. Rome is a mid-sized Italian city with ambitions.
hook.epic: One city. Seven centuries. An empire.

beats: Cannae
Hannibal crosses the Alps with elephants and destroys a Roman army. Rome keeps going anyway.
Cannae: Hannibal annihilates a Roman army in a single day.
Zama
Rome invades Africa. Hannibal loses at home.
Zama: Scipio defeats Hannibal. Carthage bows.
Carthage destroyed
Rome finishes the job. Carthage is destroyed.
146 BC: Carthage and Corinth burn. Rome rules the Mediterranean.
Alesia
Caesar conquers Gaul. Next, he wants Rome.
Alesia: Gaul falls to Julius Caesar.
Ides of March
The Senate stabs Caesar. Twenty-three times.
The Ides of March: Caesar is murdered by the Senate.
Actium
Antony and Cleopatra lose at sea. Octavian keeps everything.
Actium: Octavian wins the Roman world.
Teutoburg Forest
Three legions march into a German forest. They do not march out.
Teutoburg: three legions lost. The Rhine becomes the frontier.
Greatest extent
Under Trajan the Empire gets as big as it will ever get.
AD 117: the Empire at its greatest extent.
Constantinople founded
Constantine builds a new Rome. In what is now Turkey.
330: Constantine founds a new capital, Constantinople.
Sack of Rome
The Goths sack Rome. First time in eight hundred years.
410: Rome is sacked for the first time in eight centuries.
Last emperor in the West
The last Western emperor is a teenager. He is retired to a villa.
476: the last emperor in the West is deposed. The East endures.
end_card: Every year. Every border. Explore it yourself.
